#Corrected CTD fluorescence data
ctd_fl <- read_csv(here("outputs",
                        "flu_qc_2025-11-25.csv"))

ctd <- read_csv(here("files", "ctd_kc10_fzh01_2025-08-09.csv"))

```{r}
ctd_calc <- ctd %>% 
  mutate(date = date(`Measurement time`)) %>%
  filter(`Cast Direction Flag` == "d") %>% 
  # filter(is.na(`Fluorometry Chlorophyll flag`)) %>% 
  select(castpk = `Cast PK`,
         ctd_num =`CTD serial number`,
         date, m_time = `Measurement time`,
         station = Station,
         longitude = `Station Longitude`,
         latitude = `Station Latitude`,
         pres = `Pressure (dbar)`,
         sal = `Salinity (PSU)`,
         temp = `Temperature (deg C)`,
         turb = `Turbidity (FTU)`
         ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate absolute salinity from practical salinity
    sa = gsw_SA_from_SP(sal, pres, longitude, latitude),  # Adjust lat/lon for your study area
    # Calculate conservative temperature from in-situ temperature
    ct = gsw_CT_from_t(sa, temp, pres),
    # Calculate in-situ density (kg/m³)
    density = gsw_rho(sa, ct, pres),
    # Calculate potential density anomaly (sigma-theta, kg/m³ - 1000)
    sigma_theta = gsw_sigma0(sa, ct)
  )

daily_ctd <- ctd_calc %>%
  filter(!is.na(sal), !is.na(temp), !is.na(sigma_theta)) %>%  # Remove missing values
  
  # Step 1: Calculate daily means by depth
  group_by(date, pres, station) %>%
  summarise(
    sal_daily = mean(sal, na.rm = TRUE),
    temp_daily = mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    sigma_theta_daily = mean(sigma_theta, na.rm = TRUE),
    turb_daily = mean(turb, na.rm = TRUE),
    # o2_daily = mean(o2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )
```

```{r}
ctd_spat2 <- ctd_spat %>% 
  select(station = Station,
         cruise = Cruise,
         pres = `Pressure (dbar)`,
         mt = `Measurement time`,
         fl = `Fluorometry Chlorophyll (ug/L)`) %>% 
  mutate(date = date(mt))  

cruise_list = c("GLIDER DEPLOY", "BRK,DEAN", "DEAN")

ctd_spat2 <- ctd_spat2 %>% 
  filter(cruise %in% cruise_list)

stat <- ctd_spat2 %>% 
  distinct(station)
```


```{r}
# Filter for May profiles, depth <= 50m - FLUORESCENCE
may_profiles_fl <- ctd_fl %>%
  filter(month(date) == 5, pres <= 50) %>%
  filter(station == "KC10") %>% 
  mutate(
    year = year(date),
    highlight = ifelse(year == 2023, "May 2023", "Other May")
  )

# Filter for May profiles, depth <= 50m - TEMPERATURE & SALINITY
may_profiles_ctd <- daily_ctd %>%
  filter(month(date) == 5, pres <= 50) %>%
  filter(station == "KC10") %>% 
  mutate(
    year = year(date),
    highlight = ifelse(year == 2023, "May 2023", "Other May")
  )

# Panel 1: Fluorescence
p1_fluorescence <- ggplot(may_profiles_fl, aes(x = f_final, y = pres, group = date)) +
  geom_line(data = filter(may_profiles_fl, highlight == "Other May"),
            aes(color = highlight), 
            linewidth = 1, 
            alpha = 0.3,
            orientation = "y") +
  geom_line(data = filter(may_profiles_fl, highlight == "May 2023"),
            aes(color = highlight), 
            linewidth = 1.5,
            orientation = "y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Other May" = "gray50", "May 2023" = "#e31a1c"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(
    limits = c(50, 0),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = seq(0, 50, by = 10)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Fluorescence",
    y = "Depth (m)",
    title = "(a) Fluorescence Profiles"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Panel 2: Temperature
p2_temperature <- ggplot(may_profiles_ctd, aes(x = temp_daily, y = pres, group = date)) +
  geom_line(data = filter(may_profiles_ctd, highlight == "Other May"),
            aes(color = highlight), 
            linewidth = 1, 
            alpha = 0.3,
            orientation = "y") +
  geom_line(data = filter(may_profiles_ctd, highlight == "May 2023"),
            aes(color = highlight), 
            linewidth = 1.5,
            orientation = "y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Other May" = "gray50", "May 2023" = "#e31a1c"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(
    limits = c(50, 0),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = seq(0, 50, by = 10)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Depth (m)",
    title = "(b) Temperature Profiles"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Panel 3: Salinity
p3_salinity <- ggplot(may_profiles_ctd, aes(x = sal_daily, y = pres, group = date)) +
  geom_line(data = filter(may_profiles_ctd, highlight == "Other May"),
            aes(color = highlight), 
            linewidth = 1, 
            alpha = 0.3,
            orientation = "y") +
  geom_line(data = filter(may_profiles_ctd, highlight == "May 2023"),
            aes(color = highlight), 
            linewidth = 1.5,
            orientation = "y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Other May" = "gray50", "May 2023" = "#e31a1c"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(
    limits = c(50, 0),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = seq(0, 50, by = 10)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Salinity (PSU)",
    y = "Depth (m)",
    title = "(c) Salinity Profiles"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Panel 4: Density (assumes you have dens_daily in daily_ctd)
p4_density <- ggplot(may_profiles_ctd, aes(x = sigma_theta_daily,
                                           y = pres, group = date)) +
  geom_line(data = filter(may_profiles_ctd, highlight == "Other May"),
            aes(color = highlight), 
            linewidth = 1, 
            alpha = 0.3,
            orientation = "y") +
  geom_line(data = filter(may_profiles_ctd, highlight == "May 2023"),
            aes(color = highlight), 
            linewidth = 1.5,
            orientation = "y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Other May" = "gray50", "May 2023" = "#e31a1c"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(
    limits = c(50, 0),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = seq(0, 50, by = 10)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(paste("Density (kg ", m^{-3}, ")")),
    y = "Depth (m)",
    title = "(d) Density Profiles"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Combine all four panels
p_combined_may <- p1_fluorescence | p2_temperature | p3_salinity | p4_density

ggsave(here("figures", "may_2023_profiles_4panel.png"), 
       width = 24, height = 8, dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
# Filter to top 50m and plot fluorescence profiles colored by station
ctd_spat2 %>%
  filter(pres <= 50) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fl, y = pres, group = station, color = station)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, orientation = "y") +
  scale_y_reverse(
    limits = c(50, 0),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = seq(0, 50, by = 10)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +  # Good for many categories
  labs(
    x = "Fluorescence",
    y = "Depth (m)",
    title = "Fluorescence Profiles by Station (0-50m)",
    color = "Station"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 16, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(here("figures", "fluorescence_profiles_by_station_50m.png"), 
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
